prompt: Act as the incident commander. We have a 5xx spike on checkout, payment failures, and customer complaints from NA. Give me an incident brief, first 15-minute plan, risks, rollback criteria, and customer comms draft.

Review this production checkout design from an SRE perspective: frontend -> API gateway -> payments service -> Postgres. Target availability is 99.9%, peak traffic is 500 requests/minute, and the main concerns are payment failures, duplicate charges, DB saturation, and slow checkout. Give me risks, SLIs/SLOs, alerts, observability gaps, and highest-priority improvements.

Create a technical triage checklist for the on-call engineer for a checkout 5xx spike. Include metrics, logs, dashboards, database checks, dependency checks, and rollback validation steps. Prioritize read-only checks first.

Draft customer-facing incident communications for a checkout outage affecting North America. Include initial update, internal note, support guidance, and resolved update. Keep it concise and avoid overcommitting to root cause.
We suspect checkout pods are unhealthy in Kubernetes. What read-only checks should we run first, and what evidence would indicate CrashLoopBackOff, bad rollout, or node pressure?
As an SRE reviewing AWS spend, what should I ask the AWS Cost agent to analyze for a month-over-month cost spike? Include service, account, tag, daily average, and exclude Support/Tax views.
Review this alerting problem: checkout latency alert pages every night but resolves without action. Give me an SRE plan to reduce pager noise without hiding real incidents.
Create a post-incident review outline for a payments outage. Include timeline, impact, contributing factors, detection gaps, action items, owners, and follow-up metrics.
A checkout deploy started 20 minutes before a 5xx spike. Give me a rollback decision framework, evidence to gather, rollback criteria, and validation steps.
Users report login failures and repeated logouts after an auth config change. Build an incident brief and triage checklist for OAuth token refresh and session issues.
A region is seeing elevated CDN 403 responses after a WAF rule update. Give me read-only checks, likely blast radius, mitigation options, and customer communication risks.
Notification queue backlog is growing and oldest message age is above SLO. Give me a triage plan covering producers, workers, retries, DLQ, and downstream dependencies.
API p99 latency increased after Redis cache timeouts. Give me likely causes, metrics to inspect, mitigation options, and rollback criteria.
Design an SLO burn-rate alerting policy for checkout availability. Include short/long windows, paging criteria, ticket criteria, and false escalation tracking.
AWS spend jumped because NAT Gateway data processing increased. Give me a cost investigation plan, owner-identification steps, and optimization recommendations.
Checkout is returning intermittent 5xx and we suspect AWS infrastructure. Give me read-only AWS checks across ALB target health, security groups, EC2, RDS, S3, and recent changes.
A Kubernetes rollout is stuck and HPA is near max replicas. Give me a read-only triage plan covering deployment status, pod readiness, HPA metrics, node pressure, and rollback criteria.
Create an incident handoff note for the next on-call: current severity P2, checkout errors recovering, payments team investigating provider timeouts, next update due in 20 minutes.
Search runbooks and past incidents for checkout 5xx and payment failures. Cite relevant sources, include confidence, and turn the findings into a first 15-minute response plan.

Classify this alert: nightly checkout latency warning, resolves without action, no customer impact. Should it page, dedupe, or become a ticket? Include severity, confidence, known issue, and next checks.
